scenario.name: ramp-cpu-pt
scenario.description: Baseline re-run for task 5.5: the E-039 configuration (one yolo11n worker, PyTorch CPU, batch 1) with the 5.5 worker code, in the same session as the ONNX Runtime runs, so the before/after comparison shares host conditions. Also checks that the batched worker loop at infer_batch 1 behaves as before. Containerized ingest + one yolo11n worker + Postgres + object store, data-mini at 5 FPS per camera (1280x720 q85), steps of 1 to 5 cameras (5 added over ramp-cpu in case 4 passes), warmup 20 s, hold 90 s, 3 repetitions, no query load. Start the worker with WORKER_BACKEND=ultralytics WORKER_INFER_BATCH=1; expect_worker refuses any other configuration. Quiet host: nothing else CPU-heavy.
